specification.outcome: Verify that this repository is correctly configured for the current stock-Pi TypeScript Tiber workflow and correct any repository-local setup defects found.

scenarios.name: Valid Tiber repository setup
given: The repository contains its current project guidance, architecture, workflow rules, package configuration, and Tiber integration files
when: The repository setup is inspected against the current documented Tiber requirements
then: Required Tiber configuration and integration files are present and internally consistent
Obsolete Rust/Codex compatibility setup is not active

scenarios.name: Setup defect is found
given: A repository-local Tiber setup requirement is missing, stale, or inconsistent
when: The defect is confirmed by a failing or otherwise concrete observation
then: The smallest conforming correction is applied
A focused check demonstrates the corrected setup

acceptanceCriteria: Repository-local Tiber setup is assessed against authoritative in-repository documentation and configuration
Any confirmed setup defects within scope are corrected using behavior-focused verification
No obsolete Rust/Codex product path is restored or invoked
Relevant focused checks pass and changed file paths are reported
exclusions: Implementing unfinished product slices unrelated to repository setup
Changing machine-global Pi or Tiber installation state
Running the complete CI suite as a local delivery ritual
dependencies: Current repository documentation and active ADRs
testMappings: Setup/configuration defects map to the narrowest applicable repository check or behavior-focused test
Absence of defects maps to concrete inspection evidence and existing focused verification
specification.architectureImplications: Preserve the stock-Pi TypeScript architecture, functional-core/imperative-shell boundary, deterministic authorization, strict TypeScript constraints, and durable consequential-effect protocol.
